$comment: Default routing policy for the Lazy Router. Every ranking weight lives here: lib/config.mjs exposes this object as features["lazy-router"].routing, and lib/router/ranking.mjs uses it as the fallback for its pure scoring functions. excellentPrior and mediumPrior are v1 migration provenance only; they are accepted and preserved, never consumed by v2 scoring, which uses the continuous intelligenceCenter/intelligenceSlope prior. temperature carries the v1 default 0.60.
